Chat request with system message and user message

```typescript title="TypeScript"

  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ messages: [{ role: "system", system: { content: "You are a helpful and concise assistant" } } as Message, { role: "user", user: { content: "Hi" } } as Message], model: "gpt-4" });
```
